profile.name: Luxury Editorial (SECOMM Launchpad Fashion)
profile.description: EXAMPLE PROFILE — exercises the toolkit against the real first-party style guide. Not an implemented project: pilot execution is issue #2 and requires the contracts from issue #1 to be approved first.

businessContext.summary: Single-brand fashion storefront where brand storytelling carries the purchase decision; the homepage must feel like an editorial magazine issue that happens to sell.
businessContext.audience: Brand-loyal shoppers responding to campaign imagery and collection narratives
businessContext.commerceStrategy: brand-first: immersive hero, collection stories, curated low-density product moments

aesthetic.direction: Luxury editorial: serif display typography, generous negative space, full-bleed campaign imagery, muted ground with a single warm accent, squared corners; commerce stays quiet until the product moment.

referenceDesigns.label: Home page hero draft (source file)
referenceDesigns.note: Hero-only draft — provides the hero direction and component vocabulary, not a complete page.

constraints: Serif carries display and heading roles only; UI sans carries price/body/label.
One accent color; no promotional badges, countdowns, or urgency devices.
Photography is the section background, never a tile grid.

destination.note: Fresh dedicated file; creation blocked until the human GO is recorded here (issue #2 gate).

pages.name: 01 — Foundation
pages.purpose: Color, type, spacing reference composed from normalized tokens — the destination-side mirror of the source Library.

pages.name: 02 — Homepage (responsive)
pages.purpose: One responsive page at 1440/390: announcement bar, header, editorial hero, collection story, curated product moment, newsletter/footer — built from audited component instances with native editable text.

content.fixturePolicy: Editorial copy may be invented as clearly-marked fixtures ('SCENES FROM FALL' style). Imagery only from confirmed first-party or licensed sources; no prices, discounts, review counts, or countdowns anywhere — fixtures are brand stories, not offers. License status of source photography and typefaces must reach 'confirmed' (gate G5) before composition.

fonts.family: Open Sans (suspected UI sans, to confirm)
